parks.name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
parks.blurb: River valley between Cleveland and Akron; great blue herons, beavers, deer and coyotes.

parks.name: Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Lake Erie marsh; bald eagles, warblers, ducks and herons.

parks.name: Magee Marsh Wildlife Area
parks.blurb: Lake Erie boardwalk; migrating warblers by the thousands, herons and turtles.

parks.name: Hocking Hills State Park
parks.blurb: Caves and waterfalls; salamanders, deer, barred owls and wild turkeys.

parks.name: Mohican State Park
parks.blurb: Gorge forest on the Clear Fork; deer, bald eagles, wild turkeys and otters.

parks.name: Shawnee State Park
parks.blurb: Rugged hills called Ohio's Little Smokies; deer, black bears, owls and turkeys.

parks.name: Rocky River Reservation
parks.blurb: Cleveland Metroparks valley; deer, herons, coyotes and kingfishers.

parks.name: Pymatuning State Park
parks.blurb: Big lake and marsh; ospreys, herons, ducks and turtles.

parks.name: Caesar Creek State Park
parks.blurb: Lake and woods; fossils, bald eagles, deer and herons.

parks.name: Hueston Woods State Park
parks.blurb: Beech-maple forest and lake; deer, owls, herons and woodpeckers.

parks.name: Scioto Audubon Metro Park
parks.blurb: Columbus riverside park; peregrine falcons, herons, turtles and swallows.
